SEMANTIC MODEL

The knowledge graph is metadata you can read.

Compiled from Cognite Toolkit YAML. Containers became Iceberg tables, views became PostgreSQL views, and every relation below is a row in semantic.view_properties — not a picture someone drew.

GOVERNED QUERY

Ask the graph. Watch it compile to SQL.

The request is shaped like a CDF instances query. The model decides what is answerable: an undeclared property or traversal is rejected before any SQL is generated.
